description: This file defines helper functions for the Coocook project, providing utilities for URL name generation and username validation, independent of any specific class or framework.

methods.name: url_name
methods.description: Generates a URL-safe name by replacing non-word characters with hyphens, without case folding.

methods.name: url_names_hashref
methods.description: Returns a hashref containing the URL-safe name and its foldcased version, useful for database updates.

methods.name: username_valid
methods.description: Checks if a username string is valid, consisting only of alphanumeric characters and underscores.
